Question: Does the app enable the user to receive their personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format?
Does the app erase the user's personal data on request where the data are no longer necessary for the purpose for which they were collected?
Does the app, by default, process only the personal data necessary for each specific purpose?
Does the app encrypt personal data at rest on the user's device?
Can a user use all self-monitoring features without creating an account?
Does the app present a plain-language summary of what data leave the device before the first data transmission?
Does the app permit passwords of at least 64 characters in length?
Does the app verify prospective passwords against a list of commonly used or compromised values?
Does the app refrain from requiring periodic password rotation in the absence of evidence of compromise?
Does the app support resizing of text up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality?
Does the app render a visible focus indicator for any keyboard-operable user interface component?
Does the app provide a text alternative for each non-text content element?
